zh:
• 增加检查更新、每日自动检查和可选的自动下载安装包。下载后验证发布签名与文件校验码，安装仍交给 macOS 安装器。
• 左侧文档公式和收藏可以按公式内容、LaTeX 或序号搜索，右键即可复制 LaTeX。
• 修正编辑中仍可通过右键菜单切换公式的问题，以及兼容性说明里的旧版本号。
• 开发构建改为复制依赖，避免链接到受 macOS 保护的项目目录时启动卡住。
en:
• Check for updates, check automatically each day, and optionally download new installers. Release signatures and package checksums are verified before opening macOS Installer.
• Search document equations and favorites by content, LaTeX, or number. Copy LaTeX directly from the context menu.
• Prevent context-menu selection changes during an active operation and show the actual app version in compatibility notes.
• Copy development dependencies into the app bundle to avoid privacy checks blocking linked project files.
